responsibility: Implementation of the core RTL SSA access model and its diagnostics. This file defines the behavior of resource_info, access_info, and related access subclasses, including clobber-group maintenance, integrity checking, array merge/insert/filter operations, and pretty-printer/dump support for resources, accesses, definition nodes, and lookup results.
same_name_distinction: Defines the out-of-line behavior for the access classes declared in accesses.h, including clobber-group maintenance, access-array merge/insert filtering, integrity checks, and pretty-printer/dump routines; unlike accesses.h, it does not introduce the access/resource type interfaces themselves.
